name: WePlayTrainsGetRadar
title: WePlay: Trains Get Radar
author: afewvowels
description: Every locomotive charts the map around it like a radar, so your rail network lights up on the map as trains run. No equipment, no hidden entities, no power. Moving trains chart constantly, parked trains refresh on a slower timer, and overlapping trains share the work. Works with modded locomotives, Space Age, and Space Exploration.
